purpose: Create the Astro 6.0.0.54.94 candidate with the current standard camera fixes merged into the separate native-C Astro firmware line.

changes.summary: Merge the accepted standard mainline camera and release fixes, including the Pentax cancellation-return path and K-1 II readiness ownership fix, into the Astro branch without maintaining a second camera implementation.
Use promoted libgphoto2 main 43dccb81b92b6b25f44957a4684f534393562028, including the deferred-Bulb cancellation fix and current Pentax camera changes.
Make the Astro candidate produce the canonical release-change-manifest.json and RELEASE-IDENTITY.md, reject duplicate provenance keys, and remain separately identifiable from the standard candidate.
Run the shared camera pre-release gate and Astro native-C solver, catalogue, frame-watcher, and build-wrapper tests against the exact candidate artifact.

validation_focus: Verify the exact merged Astro commit contains the current standard mainline camera fixes and has no unintended camera-adjacent divergence from standard main.
Run the libgphoto2 deterministic regression pack and shared Polaris pre-release gate against the exact FwPkt.
Run the complete Astro native-C, dual-solver, catalogue, EXIF, frame-watch, and safety test suites.
Before any physical camera claim, verify installed provenance and run supervised K-3 III and K-1 II camera lifecycle tests separately.
known_limits: This candidate is not physical camera qualification; the shared gate and Astro tests do not prove real Polaris capture, plate-solve accuracy, EXIF writeback, drift correction, or motor safety.
The Astro bundle remains additive SD-card content and is not linked into Stage 2; it requires the documented separate SD installation step.
Live motor-rate control remains disabled and research-only.
The v93 artifact is not reused; v94 has a new identity, ZIP, manifest, and publication path.
